response.sql: WITH nationality_totals AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS constructor_entries FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_entries, AVG(constructor_entries * 1.0) OVER () AS average_entries_across_nationalities, constructor_entries - AVG(constructor_entries * 1.0) OVER () AS entries_above_or_below_average FROM nationality_totals ORDER BY nationality;
